verdict.rationale: Linear is a product-planning tool, and tools of this kind could plausibly ship a public changelog or embeddable update widget, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Linear's own changelog page (linear.app/changelog) listing its product updates. There is no documented embeddable widget that customers can use to showcase their own updates inside their product.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget
